cd /home/pc0/c1-sucesores-rec/encodat-pisos-sustancias-0001 && python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
def hdr(r,f):
    vl=r.varlist; print(f,len(vl),'nobs',r._nobs)
    typ=dict(zip(vl,r._typlist)); fmt=dict(zip(vl,r._fmtlist)); lbl=dict(zip(vl,r._lbllist))
    for v in ['id_pers','id_hogar','folio','ds2','ds3','ds9','ponde_ss','al1','al4','al9','al11','tb02','tb05','tb50','di1a','dm1a','tp1','est_var','code_upm','estrato']:
      if v in typ: print(' ',v,typ[v],fmt[v],repr(lbl[v]))
    print('  id-like:',[v for v in vl if 'id' in v.lower() or 'fol' in v.lower() or 'upm' in v.lower() or 'est' in v.lower()][:40])
with pd.read_stata('paquete/datos/ENCODAT_2016_2017_Individual.dta',iterator=True) as r: hdr(r,'IND')
with pd.read_stata('paquete/datos/ENCODAT_2016_2017_Hogar.dta',iterator=True) as r: hdr(r,'HOG')
"
